records.title: BioTac Single Contact Response
records.creators: University of Hamburg TAMS; primary collection by Philipp Ruppel, Yannick Jonetzko, Michael Görner, Norman Hendrich and Jianwei Zhang

files.name: hamburg.tar
files.version: two ROS1 bags recorded 2018-01-19; HTTP last-modified 2018-06-08

records.derivation: Decode tactile slot 0 PDC and TDC and the independently mounted six-axis wrench. Pair by nearest header time within 5 ms without extrapolation. Produce aggregate tables only.
records.limitation: Thermistor is on the BioTac fingertip. No temperature of the reference Nano17e or known true torque is paired here. Force bands identify reference magnitude, not certified free/contact states.

files.name: mao.xlsx

records.derivation: Normalize publisher values for temperature, mean Fz and SD.
records.limitation: One instrument at five ambient temperatures; published summaries only. No per-repetition chronology or concurrent independent force/torque column.

records.title: Technical note: A weighing forest floor grid lysimeter — supplement Fig. S1
records.evidence: published measurement figure; known fixed masses and ambient-temperature trace

files.name: hsup.pdf
files.version: published 2025-05-26, supplement PDF p.2 Fig. S1

records.derivation: Read vector paths and map coordinates using ticks to get approximate per-trace ranges and spans.
records.limitation: Raw field data obtainable from named institute. Zenodo 15462111 is the hardware/code release. Fixed masses 687/704/705 g are not mapped to individual trace labels. Text assigns maximum to LC3; legend assigns maximum to LC1.

records.title: Development and commissioning of an aeroacoustic test bench for the investigation of single and coaxial propeller noise — Appendix A.1.1
records.creators: Erica Gallo, Julien De Decker, Andrea Bresciani, Pauline Haezebrouck, Emanuele Garone and Christophe Schram
records.evidence: published physical measurement figure; accessible companion archive checked

files.name: acoustic2
files.version: Acta Acustica 2025, 9, 16; publisher PDF pp. 14–15, hosted mirror

records.archive_creators: Erica Gallo, Julien De Decker, Pauline Haezebrouck, Alessandro Zarri and Christophe Schram
records.derivation: Digitize loadcell-temperature line (green) and thrust line (black) from Fig. A.2 into ten one-second graphical windows.
records.limitation: Approximate pixel-derived quantities over a short stable window. Operational axial thrust measured by same cell has no second independent force reference here. Zenodo ZIP lists 70 files, including 6 axial thrust tables and 11 torque tables; thrust README explicitly limits results to 30-s means of 10-Hz captures. No raw temperature or Fig. A.2 pair file identified.

files.rights: IEEE permission is required for redistribution. Link, metadata and original evidence annotation only.

records.derivation: Record the separation between zero-load heating/cooling of isolated cast elements and ATI Gamma comparison of the fully assembled sensor.
records.limitation: Pressure/temperature counts under two rubber formulations. Separate whole six-axis experiments were run at constant temperature; figure supplies no wrist six-axis thermal coefficient.
